added.summary: A style directory may hold a theme recipe (`assets/styles/<name>/theme.json`) instead of a pack.json: the cook compiles it into the style's pack and draws its art (cached by spec under `.og/ui-art/`), and a look's `ui "<name>"` names it as any style. `ui "<name>"` also finds an engine theme (`@themes/<name>`) before a built-in style, and only the named theme is bundled. A style with both files is an error.

A compiled theme gives each art slot its own ink (`art-<piece>-fg`), solved on the art it draws, and moves every ink role in OKLCH lightness until it holds its ratio on the theme's art as well as the design's surfaces.
